messages.message: This relative efficiency curve has no gammas here.
The freely-fit peak area came out negative, so there is no efficiency to show.
Not statistically significant compared to its uncertainty.
Most of the counts here come from neighboring peaks' tails, so a small peak-shape mismatch would dominate the value.
The peak is not fully contained within its ROI, so its area is not fully measured.
These peaks were left off the chart because their measured efficiency would not be meaningful:
Blended: this curve is assigned {1}% of the counts here. The split between curves is a model assumption, not a measurement.
